settings.hero_desc: A finely detailed scale model of a gas process skid - multi-level structure, pipework, valves, vessels and access ladders, reproduced to scale on a branded base. A precise, professional showcase of complex process equipment.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your skid/package, branding, scale and display case
settings.s1_body: Process skids are dense with detail - pipework, valves, vessels and platforms packed onto a compact frame. We reproduce all of it to scale, capturing the multi-level structure and access ladders so clients can see exactly what your package contains. Mounted on a branded base, it is the perfect showcase for sales meetings, exhibitions and reception displays in the oil, gas and process industries.
settings.case_body: Built as a scale model for Arabian Industries for their MakeIT Exhibition, this piece let them showcase a complex product to clients in three dimensions - far clearer than a drawing, and a memorable centrepiece at exhibitions and in the boardroom.
settings.case_quote: We used this model at the MakeIT Exhibition. It made explaining our equipment to visitors far easier.
settings.prov_p: The density of a process skid is hard to convey on paper. A detailed scale model shows the layout, access and complexity at a glance - and signals the quality of your engineering.
